name: com.mexcheck/mexcheck
title: MexCheck
description: Mexican RFC/SAT 69-B, CFDI, CURP (RENAPO) and INE checks against the official registries.

tools.name: rfc_validate
tools.description: Full RFC validation (cert lookup + zip search + lists). Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/validate".

include_curp.description: Enable RENAPO identity lookup for the taxpayer or legal representative when a CURP is available. Adds 5 credits to the request (15 total, $0.225 USD pay-as-you-go).

name.description: Optional. When provided, cert lookup and zip search run in parallel (6–10 s instead of 7–11 s) and a zip is recovered even when the RFC has zero CSDs. Registered taxpayer name as it appears in SAT. **Companies:** omit legal-entity suffixes (S.A. de C.V., SAPI de C.V., SOFOM, AC, SC, etc.). **Persons:** legal name with no honorifics. See top-level `Names` section.

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: rfc_verify
tools.description: Verify an RFC, optionally against a name + zip. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/verify".

name.description: Optional. Requires `zip`. Registered taxpayer name as it appears in SAT. **Companies:** omit legal-entity suffixes (S.A. de C.V., SAPI de C.V., SOFOM, AC, SC, etc.). **Persons:** legal name with no honorifics. See top-level `Names` section.

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: rfc_profile
tools.description: Look up the registered taxpayer's personal data. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/profile".

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: rfc_find_zip
tools.description: Find the SAT-registered zip for a known RFC + name. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/find-zip".

name.description: Registered taxpayer name as it appears in SAT. **Companies:** omit legal-entity suffixes (S.A. de C.V., SAPI de C.V., SOFOM, AC, SC, etc.). **Persons:** legal name with no honorifics. See top-level `Names` section.

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: rfc_sat_lists
tools.description: List SAT-published contributor lists an RFC appears in. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/sat-lists".

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: rfc_import_export
tools.description: Check SAT's importer and exporter registries for an RFC. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/import-export".

rfc.description: The RFC number to validate (12 or 13 characters)

tools.name: cfdi_verify
tools.description: Verify a CFDI with SAT. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "cfdi/endpoints/cfdi-verify".

retention.description: true when the folio is a CFDI de retenciones, which SAT checks apart from invoices. Not needed with `xml`: a retention's XML is recognized.

uuid.description: Folio fiscal (UUID) of the CFDI, any case.

xml.description: The CFDI XML document as a string, as stamped by the PAC (with its tfd:TimbreFiscalDigital).

tools.name: csf_verify
tools.description: Read and verify a Constancia de Situación Fiscal. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "rfc/endpoints/csf-verify".

file.description: The constancia as base64: the PDF SAT generated, or a PNG or JPEG image of it. A `data:` URL prefix is accepted. Up to 8 MB.

id_cif.description: The idCIF printed under the taxpayer's name on the constancia's first page.

qr.description: The text of a QR code printed on the constancia (a siat.sat.gob.mx validadorqr URL), or an array with both. The first-page QR returns the taxpayer; the seal QR returns the issue date.

tools.name: curp_lookup
tools.description: Look up a CURP in RENAPO. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "curp/endpoints/curp-lookup".

tools.name: curp_basic
tools.description: Look up a CURP (fast identity). Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "curp/endpoints/curp-basic".

tools.name: curp_search
tools.description: Find a CURP by personal data. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "curp/endpoints/curp-search".

mothers_maiden_name.description: Omit when the person has a single surname.

state.description: Two-letter state of birth code as used in CURPs (e.g. DF, JC, NL), or NE for people born abroad.

tools.name: ine_verify
tools.description: Verify a voter ID with INE. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "ine/endpoints/ine-verify".

cic.description: Credential identification code: the nine digits after IDMEX on the first line on the back.

id_ciudadano.description: Citizen identifier, models E to J: the last nine digits of the first line on the back. Send this or `ocr`.

ocr.description: OCR, model D. Send this or `id_ciudadano`.

tools.name: ine_session_create
tools.description: Create a hosted verification session. Returns a link (url) to send to the person, who opens it on their own phone, photographs their voter ID, and records a short video. Billed to the connected account when created (see get_account) and refunded if it expires unfinished. The result is not stored: read it with ine_session_get within 15 minutes of the person finishing. Only create one when the user asks to verify someone. Details: read_doc "ine/endpoints/ine-sessions".

allow_desktop.description: Let the hosted page also run with a computer's webcam. By default it only runs on a phone or tablet; a computer is shown the link's QR code to continue on a phone.

expires_in.description: Seconds the link works for: 60 to 259200 (three days).

locale.description: Language of the hosted page. `es` is read as `es_MX`.

redirect_url.description: Where the closing screen's Continue button takes the person; `session_id` is added to its query string. http or https.

reference.description: Your own label for the session, up to 200 bytes (an order or user id). It comes back on the session. Do not put personal data in it.

verify.description: Also ask INE about the credential, as `/ine/verify` does. +10 credits.

verify_curp.description: Also ask RENAPO about the card's CURP, as `/curp/lookup` does. +5 credits.

tools.name: geo_zip
tools.description: Look up what a Mexican zip code covers. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "geo/endpoints/geo-zip".

zip.description: The five-digit zip code, as a string so a leading zero is kept.

tools.name: geo_zip_search
tools.description: Find the zip codes of a place in Mexico. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "geo/endpoints/geo-zip-search".

municipality.description: Letters found anywhere in the municipality's name.

settlement.description: Letters found anywhere in the settlement's name.

state.description: The state's name or how it starts (`Veracruz`). `Estado de México` and `CDMX` are understood. Narrows a search; cannot be sent alone.

zip.description: The first two to five digits of the zip code.

tools.name: cfe_verify
tools.description: Verify a CFE electricity receipt. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "cfe/endpoints/cfe-verify".

file.description: The receipt as base64: CFE's PDF, a scan, or a PNG or JPEG photo that shows the payment barcode. A `data:` URL prefix is accepted. Up to 8 MB. Send this, or the three values below.

name.description: The holder's name exactly as the receipt prints it, cut short if the receipt cuts it short.

total.description: The amount to pay (Total a pagar) in whole pesos.

tools.name: cedula_search
tools.description: Search cédulas profesionales at SEP. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "cedula/endpoints/cedula-search".

cedula.description: The cédula number, up to 8 digits. A shorter number is padded with zeros to SEP's 7 digits.

mothers_maiden_name.description: The second surname. Narrows a common name.

tools.name: ine_session_get
tools.description: Read a hosted verification session made with ine_session_create: its status, and the result for 15 minutes after the person finishes. Free. Details: read_doc "ine/endpoints/ine-sessions".

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Lists the API documentation pages, grouped by product: general (quickstart, authentication, errors, pricing, webhooks), rfc, cfdi, curp, ine, geo, cfe, and cedula. Free, and works without logging in.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Returns one documentation page as Markdown. Free, and works without logging in.

id.description: A page id from list_docs, e.g. "curp/endpoints/curp-lookup".

tools.name: get_openapi_operation
tools.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 definition of one REST endpoint, with the schemas it references, to generate a typed client from. Free, and works without logging in.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Shows which account this connection acts as (personal or an organization, and the role), its plan, credits used, balance, and what each tool costs it. Free.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Creates an API key on the connected account for the user's server to call the REST API with, and returns it once. Create one only when the user asks for it or the integration needs it; keys are listed and revoked in the dashboard. While building or testing an integration, create a test key: it answers from fictional people and companies, never reaches a registry, and is never billed.

name.description: A label to tell the key apart, e.g. "Production".

test.description: true for a test key (rfc_test_...), which returns fictional data for the documented test identifiers. Default false.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Lists the plans the connected account can buy, with their prices. Free.

tools.name: create_plan_checkout
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link where the user subscribes the connected account to a plan. Charges nothing by itself: give the link to the user to open and pay.

tools.name: create_balance_checkout
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link where the user adds prepaid balance to the connected account. Charges nothing by itself: give the link to the user to open and pay.

tools.name: charge_saved_card
tools.description: Charges the connected account's saved card and adds the amount to its balance. This spends the user's money at once. It only works if the user allowed card charges when connecting, up to their daily limit (see get_account). Use it when the user asked you to, or told you to keep the balance funded.

tools.name: get_billing_portal_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the Stripe billing portal, where the user changes or cancels the plan, updates the card, and downloads invoices.
